title: Japan's Takarakuji lottery accounts hit by password list attack
what_changed: Date changed from 17 November (Security NEXT publication day) to 13 November, the day the selling prefectures and designated cities announced the scope (Impress Watch). Removed an occurred_at of 00:00 on 5 November that no source states; Impress Watch dates the logins to 4 November, Security NEXT to 4 and 5 November. Added Impress Watch as a second source.
